title: Sparkly trophy
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow behind trophy -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='34' fill='#3a2f00' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- handles -->
  <path d='M28 24 C14 24 12 44 30 48' fill='none' stroke='#ffd24a' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 24 C86 24 88 44 70 48' fill='none' stroke='#ffd24a' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cup -->
  <path d='M28 20 H72 V36 C72 52 62 60 50 60 C38 60 28 52 28 36 Z' fill='#ffd24a'/>
  <!-- cup shine -->
  <path d='M36 24 H43 V36 C43 44 40 50 35 53 C33 46 34 30 36 24 Z' fill='#fff3b0' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- cup rim -->
  <rect x='26' y='17' width='48' height='8' rx='4' fill='#ffe98a'/>
  <!-- cup inner shadow edge -->
  <path d='M56 22 H68 V36 C68 50 61 57 56 58 Z' fill='#e8a92a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x='45' y='60' width='10' height='10' fill='#f0b830'/>
  <rect x='45' y='60' width='4' height='10' fill='#ffe98a'/>
  <!-- base -->
  <rect x='34' y='70' width='32' height='7' rx='3' fill='#ffd24a'/>
  <rect x='34' y='70' width='32' height='3' rx='2' fill='#ffe98a'/>
  <rect x='30' y='77' width='40' height='9' rx='4' fill='#e8a92a'/>
  <rect x='30' y='77' width='40' height='3' rx='2' fill='#f7c94a'/>
  <!-- star on cup -->
  <path d='M50 30 L52.9 36.5 L60 37.2 L54.7 42 L56.2 49 L50 45.4 L43.8 49 L45.3 42 L40 37.2 L47.1 36.5 Z' fill='#ff7bb0'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g stroke='#bff0ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <path d='M18 14 L18 26 M12 20 L24 20'/>
    <path d='M84 12 L84 20 M80 16 L88 16'/>
    <path d='M88 62 L88 72 M83 67 L93 67'/>
    <path d='M12 60 L12 68 M8 64 L16 64'/>
    <path d='M50 8 L50 14 M47 11 L53 11'/>
  </g>
  <g stroke='#ffe98a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <path d='M26 82 L26 88 M23 85 L29 85'/>
    <path d='M74 80 L74 86 M71 83 L77 83'/>
  </g>
</svg>
